title: How land formalisation protects widows from dispossession
summary: A land formalisation programme in Benin significantly increased the likelihood that widows – especially those without a son – remained in their villages, offering formal institutional protection where customary norms left women most vulnerable.

title: How China became a global pharmaceutical powerhouse

title: How targeting cash transfers at women strengthens bargaining power within the household
summary: In Mexico, income transfers targeted at women are effective at improving their decision-making position within the household, translating into significant changes in household consumption and time allocation patterns.

title: When microfinance credit contracted in India, children’s education suffered
summary: In Andhra Pradesh, credit contraction in the rural economy, triggered by microfinance regulation, lowered educational investments and caused lasting learning losses, with larger effects for girls and younger children.

title: An improved nighttime-lights dataset for development research

title: The long shadow of the 1997 financial crisis in Thailand
